# nginxproxymanager_redirection_host (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_redirection_host" "example" {
  forward_domain_name = "test123.com"
  forward_http_code   = 301
  forward_scheme      = "https"
  domain_names        = ["domain123.com"]

  http2_support  = true
  certificate_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_names` (Set of String) Domain names to accept. NPM stores these sorted, so the order doesn't matter.
- `forward_domain_name` (String) Domain name to redirect the request to.
- `forward_http_code` (Number) HTTP code to redirect with, between 300 and 308.
- `forward_scheme` (String) Scheme to redirect with, `http`, `https` or `auto` to keep the scheme of the request.

### Optional

- `advanced_config` (String) Advanced NGINX config.
- `block_exploits` (Boolean) Whether to block exploits
- `certificate_id` (Number) ID of the certificate to use.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the redirection host.
- `hsts_enabled` (Boolean) Enable HSTS.
- `hsts_subdomains` (Boolean) Enable HSTS for subdomains.
- `http2_support` (Boolean) Whether to enable HTTP2 support.
- `preserve_path` (Boolean) Whether to preserve the request path in the redirected request.
- `ssl_forced` (Boolean) Whether to force SSL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the redirection host.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) ID of the user which owns the redirection host.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the ID shown in the NPM UI or API
terraform import nginxproxymanager_redirection_host.example 1
```
